anniversaries_kind_fields.name: anniversaries_kind_fields
anniversaries_kind_fields.value:
("anniversaries"."kind" = 'birthday') = ("anniversaries"."birthday_of" is not null)
        and ("anniversaries"."kind" = 'other') = ("anniversaries"."name" is not null)
        and ("anniversaries"."kind" = 'birthday' or "anniversaries"."year" is not null)

anniversaries_date.name: anniversaries_date
anniversaries_date.value:
"anniversaries"."month" between 1 and 12 and "anniversaries"."day" between 1 and 31
        and make_date(coalesce("anniversaries"."year", 2000), "anniversaries"."month", 1) + ("anniversaries"."day" - 1)
          < make_date(coalesce("anniversaries"."year", 2000), "anniversaries"."month", 1) + interval '1 month'

backup_outbox_space_fields.name: backup_outbox_space_fields
backup_outbox_space_fields.value:
case "backup_outbox"."target" when 'space' then num_nulls("backup_outbox"."space_id", "backup_outbox"."epoch_id") = 0
        else num_nonnulls("backup_outbox"."space_id", "backup_outbox"."epoch_id") = 0 end

gifts_preview_pending.name: gifts_preview_pending
gifts_preview_pending.where: "gifts"."link" is not null and "gifts"."preview_read_at" is null

gifts_status.name: gifts_status
gifts_status.value:
case "gifts"."status"
        when 'preparing' then "gifts"."private_to" is not distinct from "gifts"."giver_id"
          and num_nonnulls("gifts"."revealed_at", "gifts"."revealed_by", "gifts"."gift_date") = 0
        when 'revealed' then "gifts"."private_to" is null
          and num_nulls("gifts"."revealed_at", "gifts"."revealed_by", "gifts"."gift_date") = 0
        else false end

space_actions_kind.name: space_actions_kind
space_actions_kind.value: (record_type = 'wish' and kind in ('prepare', 'unprepare', 'receive')) or (record_type = 'gift' and kind in ('reveal', 'set_date', 'set_occasion')) or (record_type = 'anniversary' and kind in ('set_date', 'set_count'))

users_sleep_grid.name: users_sleep_grid
users_sleep_grid.value:
"users"."sleep_start_minute" between 0 and 1425 and "users"."sleep_start_minute" % 15 = 0
        and "users"."sleep_end_minute" between 0 and 1425 and "users"."sleep_end_minute" % 15 = 0
        and "users"."sleep_start_minute" <> "users"."sleep_end_minute"

wishes_preview_pending.name: wishes_preview_pending
wishes_preview_pending.where: "wishes"."link" is not null and "wishes"."preview_read_at" is null
